test_io_plugin_predicate_no_serializatio: test the io plugin predicate pushdown without serialization for json_path_match expressions
test_defer_validate_true: test that pl.defer with validate_schema=True raises SchemaError on type mismatch
test_defer_validate_false: test that pl.defer with validate_schema=False skips schema validation and returns raw data
test_empty_iterator_io_plugin: test that register_io_source with an empty iterator returns an empty DataFrame matching the schema
test_scan_lines: test a custom line-by-line file scanner built with register_io_source using a BytesIO stream
test_datetime_io_predicate_pushdown: test datetime predicate pushdown through an io plugin source with expression meta extraction
test_reordered_columns: test that register_io_source correctly handles reordered column selection and row indexing
test_io_plugin_reentrant_deadlock: test that reentrant io plugin sources do not deadlock with a single-threaded pool
test_io_plugin_categorical: test that io plugin sources correctly handle multi-chunk DataFrames with Categorical columns
test_io_plugin_object_dtype: test that pl.defer correctly handles Object dtype columns and preserves values on collect
